description: La Louvière - comptages statiques des flux automobiles, cyclistes et pédestres is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de La Louvière. Recensement de l'affluence des véhicules automobiles par la ville de La Louvière The 4 datasets in this record: Comptages statiques des flux automobiles La Louvière; Comptages statiques des flux cyclistes La Louvière; Comptages statiques des flux pédestres La Louvière; Localisation des points de comptages de circulation La Louvière. Coverage: La Louvière. The portal lists 4 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are automobile, comptage, passage, statique. The portal shows 7,056 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
